description: v0.5.1 Session plugin bridge for the unofficial VamMCP server. Load as a Session Plugin so it survives scene changes. Supports scene/look/clothing/pose, facial expressions, and lock_head.
credits: Unofficial community project. Not affiliated with Mesh VR / Virt-A-Mate.
instructions:
1. User Preferences -> Security -> Enable Plugins (recommended: Plugins Always Enabled).
2. Put this .var in AddonPackages (or use the loose Custom/Scripts copy for development) and restart VAM.
3. Main UI (Esc) -> Session Plugins -> Add Plugin -> VamMcp.Bridge -> VamMcpBridge.cs. Leave enabled on.
4. Session Plugin Presets -> Change User Defaults -> Set Current As User Defaults.
5. Run the vam-mcp Python server with VAM_ROOT pointed at this install.
6. Keep VAM running. The plugin polls Saves/PluginData/vam-mcp/command.json
